{{Quote|Tormen's a monster. His troops have been butchering Corellians. On Rabaan, he flattened kilometers of homes, businesses, hospitals.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus|Janarus]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:NOwaB" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tormen]] conducted a '''campaign''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rabaan]] that resulted in an Imperial victory. After securing the world, Tormen moved his forces to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to aid in the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="TOR:TAtT" />
